errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis labels are shown every year, but they are shown every two years (1987, 1989, 1991, etc.).
The line for TSEB is blue in the chart, not green. The green line represents TSEC.

This statement is confusing and incorrect in context. The description previously and wrongly stated the TSEB line is green. While the TSEC line is indeed green, stating it is 'also' green implies both lines have the same color, which is false. The TSEB line is blue.

errors.text_span: steigt bis etwa 400 Euro pro Hektar um 1995 und bleibt danach relativ stabil bei etwa 400 bis 450 Euro pro Hektar bis 2017
errors.evidence: This description of the TSEB line is an over-generalization. After 1995, the line does not remain 'relatively stable'; it continues to rise to a prominent peak of approximately 570 Euro in 2003 before declining.

errors.text_span: fällt bis auf etwa 100 Euro pro Hektar im Jahr 2011
errors.evidence: The TSEC line drops to a minimum value of approximately 50 Euro pro Hektar in 2011, not 100 Euro pro Hektar.
